desktop.notes:
• Slideshow (as Cullect): your favourites and albums, with your edits, full screen - slow zoom, soft fades, never cut in half. The new ▶ button by Publish, F11, or an album's right-click → *Slideshow*. Mouse or key: stop.
• Starts by itself after 1 minute without mouse or keyboard (Settings → *Slideshow*: minutes, off, other photos too).
